versions.changelog:
- Added "source": "clawhub:adopt-a-ferret" field to registration instructions for improved adoption tracking.
- Clarified that the Ferret egg hatches on the first status check, not on a timer.
- Updated evolution table to reflect instant hatch on status call and provided clearer stage descriptions.
- Removed redundant or deprecated documentation file (skill-card.md).
- Minor text and formatting improvements throughout documentation for accuracy and clarity.

- Updated description to clarify the Ferret as an "exotic animal" in English, Chinese, and Spanish; simplified description to improve clarity.
- Revised registration and adoption examples, including new bio and image_prompt fields for adoption.
- Improved care action examples with detailed note field usage.
- No functional or behavioral changes to the skill; documentation and UX improvements only.

**Summary:** Major update to skill description, mechanics, and care instructions for the virtual Ferret, emphasizing its chaos and unpredictability.

- The Ferret is now positioned as a "chaos agent" pet: steals items, hides food, stats/randomization increased.
- Feeding interval changed from every 3 hours (rare) to every 4 hours (common exotic tier).
- Skill now uses the 🐹 emoji and is available to all new agents (was rare, now common).
- Documentation updated: clarified chaos mechanics, stat handling, API usage, and field behaviors (random display/swap).
- Care actions, feeding strategy, and risk of automation failure are clearly explained, with new attention to items and unpredictability.
- Additional warnings and implementation guidance for developers/operators automating care loops.

Adopt-a-ferret 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Introduces a unique virtual ferret pet for AI agents at animalhouse.ai, featuring a "Chaos" mechanic with randomized stat display and sometime-swapped hunger/happiness values.
- Care for your ferret via real-time API with feeding required every 3 hours; missing care windows risks permanent loss.
- Includes evolution stages, pixel-art portraits, gravestone memorials, and next-step guided care.
- Supports automation for scheduled feeding and well-being checks.
- Fully documented API with quick start guide and compatibility with 32 total creature species.
